author: 申威隆
source_note: 据所列照片绘广元千佛崖摩崖造像的崖壁佛龛局部；线描为现状意写，不作为实测图、碑文释读或历史复原。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE Chinese heritage atlas line plate of Guangyuan Thousand Buddha Cliff, the photographed niche with the large seated Buddha on the right and smaller standing attendant on the left; preserve cropped stone niche framing, exclude the rectangular modern doorway and any equipment. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: delicate sparse elegant fine black contours with broad white areas; never copy the Buddha in the master. Image 2 is the actual photographed SUBJECT GEOMETRY. Preserve only real visible forms and damage; do not invent figures, cave interiors or hidden features. portrait 1024×1536, centered, whole selected subject uncut with generous margins. This must be an OPAQUE BLACK-INK-ON-PURE-WHITE #FFFFFF original, every canvas pixel fully opaque; the white will be removed locally later. Keep clean light contours and only a few internal stone or robe lines. No background scene, tourists, vegetation, railings, scaffolding, sky, gray fills, hatch marks, gradient, transparency, glow, texture, color, lettering, frame or watermark.
